technologyDelivery.label: Not supported
technologyDelivery.description: The product does not provide this capability.

technologyDelivery.label: Public roadmap
technologyDelivery.description: Planned, not currently available to customers.

technologyDelivery.label: Private preview
technologyDelivery.description: Available only to selected preview customers; excluded from current GA coverage.

technologyDelivery.label: Public preview
technologyDelivery.description: Available for preview, but not generally available yet.

technologyDelivery.label: GA via a required partner or managed service
technologyDelivery.description: Available today, but a partner or managed service must deliver it. Not a native out-of-the-box product capability.

technologyDelivery.label: GA, customer build required
technologyDelivery.description: The customer must create and maintain workflows, agents, connectors, or code. A connector or API alone does not count as a pre-built solution.

technologyDelivery.label: GA with configuration
technologyDelivery.description: A shipped capability needs configuration, permissions, or tuning, but no new workflow, agent, or connector needs to be built.

technologyDelivery.label: GA out of the box
technologyDelivery.description: A pre-built solution ships with the product and works after standard onboarding. No custom build is required.

autonomy.label: Manual
autonomy.description: The person performs the work. No autonomy.

autonomy.label: Collaborator
autonomy.description: The system assists; the human acts.

autonomy.label: Guide
autonomy.description: The system proposes; a human approves before execution.

autonomy.label: Approver
autonomy.description: The system acts within policy; a human can veto or intervene.

autonomy.label: Automated
autonomy.description: The system runs end to end within the assessed boundary, without case-by-case human involvement.
